blocking_issues: Nothing in the plan pins the workbench to one trace, and the planned e2e assertion compares against a panel that keeps changing, so `make e2e` is likely to fail. On the Live page and Live watch the workbench replays 'the stream's latest trace' (matchStore keeps the latest), but the plan never says that a replay already running keeps the trace it started with. At 20x, fresh-first reruns (D-175) bring a new `match` and `matcher_trace` about every 0.7-0.85 s. Replaying 50 candidates at 6 per second plus the shortlist and fusion stages takes about 10 s. A dialog that follows the store therefore restarts and never settles. If it does pin, `e2e/workbench.spec.ts`'s check 'the final top 5 equals the Matches panel's' compares a settled rerun with a Matches panel that has moved on by about 10 reruns. Live fusion scores sit near 1.0 (phase 11 REPORT) and ties are broken by prefilter order, so the order shuffles. Fix: (a) the dialog snapshots the trace when it opens and names its rerun in the header. A newer trace only enables a 'Newer rerun available, replay it' control and does not restart the replay. (b) The e2e compares the settled fused top 5 with the matches the app showed for the same rerun. Either read the Matches panel's T+ and entries at the moment the dialog opens and assert that the trace's `query.at_s` and ranking match them, or open the workbench after the incident has closed, when no fresh rerun follows and the panel and the latest trace are the same rerun.
suggestions: Under D-068, the paths for 'the first 50 in computed order' are the top 50 by vector distance. At T+90 two of the four P1 flights sit at prefilter ranks 122 and 314, so the fused top 5 can contain tracks that were never aligned on screen. Also record paths, curves and thumbnails for every top-10 ranking track outside the first 50 (only a few extra alignments), or mark the top-5 entries that were not replayed.

Add Pause and Step to the speed control and Replay. The guide's 'workbench mid-replay' shot needs a deterministic pause the planned controls cannot give, and WCAG 2.2.2 asks for a pause on auto-moving content that lasts more than 5 s. Expose data-stage, data-step and data-track attributes for Playwright.

guide.spec.ts: every new image name must be a literal `snap(page, "live-mode-...")` call, because test_docs' SNAP regex reads only literals (no template strings or loops). Use whole-page screenshots at 1440x900 or 1920x1080, each at least 20 KB, each distinct (check_docs also hashes them).

docs/USER_GUIDE.md already has a '### Live mode' subsection in §6, the CLI reference. A new 'Live mode' section creates a duplicate slug, so `#live-mode` links resolve to the old one. Merge or rename one of them, and don't renumber sections that README or other docs link to (test_docs checks anchors).

The new live specs (workbench.spec.ts and the guide's live test) should POST /api/live/reset before and after, and reseed after, as livemode.spec.ts does. The launcher runs one simulator at a time (SimulatorBusy, 409), and a test that ends before its flight closes leaves one running.

Label the path honestly. The trace path and thumbnail come from the full-matrix (unbanded) alignment with relaxed ends, because of dtw_rerank's workaround for dtaidistance's band-edge bug, while the reported distance is banded. If the thumbnail draws the Sakoe-Chiba corridor, the path may leave it: say so on screen or don't draw the band.
api/schemas.py is already 505 lines (the convention is about 400). Put MatcherTraceMsg and its nested models in a new `api/schemas_trace.py` and import them into both unions.

In the contract tests, keep TYPES_16_3 as the §16.3 set and add a separate extension set ({'matcher_trace'}) so test names stay accurate. test_api_live_contract imports TYPES_16_3, and its length assertion becomes 17.
The toy P1 index may return fewer than 50 candidates. Test the TRACE_PATHS cutoff with TraceRecorder(paths=small) so the 'paths only for the first N' branch is really exercised.

Accessibility (§17.12, axe): give the native dialog an accessible name (aria-labelledby). Give the SVG curves and cost thumbnail role=img with an aria-label (axe svg-img-alt is serious). Provide a text equivalent for the current candidate (track, distance, similarity, ms). Use --ink-low only at 18 px or larger.
The 12-per-second speed is above the 10 Hz React update cap (§17.11). Either cap the speed at 10 or document that two candidates can land in one update.

Record the matcher_trace message size in bytes and the per-incident cache size after CACHE_FORMAT 2 in REPORT.md. 500 prefilter, DTW and fusion rows plus 50 paths and thumbnails is about 0.3-0.4 MB per rerun. If it is larger, consider column arrays instead of per-row objects.

Process: uncommitted phase-12 code already exists before this review (match/trace.py, candidates.py, dtw_rerank.py and matcher.py; runner.py and feed.py are being changed now). Bring it in line with the revised plan and commit it before the gate, which requires a clean tree. The plan's 'push' step rests on D-171 (CLAUDE.md says never push), so cite D-171 there.
summary: The plan is thorough. It covers all four tasks (trace, streaming plus GET routes plus regenerated OpenAPI, the workbench on the Live page, Live watch and the Match explainer, and the docs), names concrete Python, Vitest and Playwright tests for every test bullet, maps each part of the exit check to a command and its evidence (including timestamps proving the guide's screenshots came from this run's `make e2e`), lists every README and phase file it will create or update, and needs no human decision. Its main deviation is reasonable and honestly labelled. Under D-068's 500 candidates (the block assumed 50), D-187 keeps scalar DTW fields for all 500 and paths, curves and thumbnails for the first 50, and says so on screen ('500 alignments computed in X ms; the first 50 replayed at 6 per second'). It respects truth isolation, no look-ahead, ports and adapters, the append-only ledger, rule 10 and tokens-only. A spot-check of the work already in progress (TraceRecorder, alignment(), the timing exclusions) matches the plan. One blocking gap: the workbench is not pinned to the trace it opened with, and the e2e check 'the final top 5 equals the Matches panel's' compares against a panel that a fresh rerun updates about every second at 20x, so `make e2e` would likely fail or be flaky. Fix that, and consider the suggestions on top-5 path coverage, a pause control for the guide shot, literal snap() names, and the duplicate 'Live mode' anchor.
